title: Adversarial Security & Infrastructure Hardening
description: Hardens Taawun against ethics engine regex bypasses, unauthenticated P2P relay impersonation, Docker CLI privilege escalation, mixed-content CSP blocks, and WebSocket bandwidth exhaustion.
keyDecisions: HMAC-SIGNED SIGNALING TOKENS. Web P2P relay requires cryptographic signed JWT/HMAC session tokens to prevent peer impersonation and cross-tenant eavesdropping.

OFFICIAL DOCKER GO SDK & CONTAINER ISOLATION. Migrate from exec.Command CLI to official Docker Go SDK with non-root user (1000:1000), read-only root filesystem, cap-drop=ALL, and explicit image whitelist.
AST SEMANTIC PARSING FOR TAQWA AUDIT. Replace string regex matching with AST symbolic parsing and LLM semantic auditing for code paths handling financial math and fees.
WSS SECURE WEBSOCKETS & 64KB RELAY CAP. Enforce wss:// TLS for browser sandbox compatibility and cap relay frames at 64KB to prevent bandwidth exhaustion.
